name: Logistic Lab
desc: A logistic-map lab: the r slider sweeps the bifurcation diagram from fixed point through period-doubling to chaos, with period and Lyapunov exponent shown live.
controls: Parameter-r and start-x0 sliders, four presets (fixed/period-2/period-4/chaos), time-series toggle, reset; keys 1–4 load presets, R resets
creator: Original build (Dragon Gaming Assets)
